name: ant_bivouac
description: Army-ant bivouac, the living nest: a big lumpy hanging sack made entirely of interlocked dark red-brown worker bodies (darker #5a2a18 interior, #3a160c shading, #a0583a speckle highlights), legs and antennae bristling all round the edge, small dark airway holes, short ant chains dangling from the bottom (none in the middle 120 units, bottom edge clean for Doug's legs), flat gripping top. Top-centre anchor (0,0) = attachment point; x -310..310, y 0..560. Works as a silhouette.
